sections.title: Mode ofApproach
sections.text: The station is well connected by all weather road. The nearest Railway Station is Puri which is 6 Km from Puri Lighthouse. Nearest Airport is Bhubaneswar which is approx. 60 km from Puri LH.

sections.title: Facilities Available
sections.text:
Post Office, Primary Health Center, Police Station and Kendriya Vidyalaya all are within radius of 8 KM from Puri Lighthouse.
